description: Lifecycle hooks for the agentic SDLC orchestrator: append-only audit + gate/high-impact enforcement.

sessionStart.name: graph-validate
sessionStart.description: Validates v2 workflow-graph fields and referenced templates/standards (v2 §10).

preToolUse.name: gate-check
preToolUse.description: Blocks high-impact / gated actions until policy checks pass and human confirmation is recorded.

postToolUse.name: audit-tool-use
postToolUse.description: Appends every tool action to the append-only audit log.
